review_scope: All new Task #576 Python surfaces, minimal integer-plane integration, real n24/n600 receipts, and authority labels

findings.finding: The first dispatched packet validator raised TypeError on every valid packet.
findings.resolution: Removed the invalid constructor call; strict decode plus canonical re-encode equality is now the only acceptance path.

findings.finding: The first non-identifiability witness could select two vectors assigned to the same class and had an invalid fallback reshape.
findings.resolution: Bounded deterministic search retains one representative per distinct class and broadcasts only after two classes exist.

findings.finding: Whole-array finiteness checks and hashing contradicted the n600 streaming contract.
findings.resolution: Validation, field hashing, uint16 label hashing, counts, and receiver arithmetic now run pair-by-pair. Read-only memmap pages receive best-effort MADV_DONTNEED after consumption.

findings.finding: The first label hash cast uint16 class IDs to uint8, permitting hash collisions outside the current five-class fixture.
findings.resolution: Partition hashes use canonical little-endian uint16 label bytes.
findings.regression: n24 and n600 deterministic replay hashes

findings.finding: The first pass omitted the executable probe and integer-plane blocker integration.
findings.resolution: Added the bounded probe and routed the exact blocker into the byte-close receipt without enabling receiver_consumed.

findings.finding: The first equation mislabeled local evidence as contest CPU and carried no empirical anchor.
findings.resolution: Relabeled macOS-CPU advisory, attached the measured n600 blocker anchor, and registered it through the locked helper.

checks.real_n600_replay: packet, field, partition hash, counts, and mutation canary equal

remaining_main_review: Re-run the focused tests and n24 probe from the base-to-head diff.
